verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada runs its own 'services, fees and processing times' page. It lists processing times per transaction type and channel: online incorporation takes 1 day, express takes 4 hours for $100 extra, email or mail takes 10 days, amendments take 1 day and exemptions take 30 days. This directly delivers published, transaction-specific times from the service itself. Missing for 10: evidence that these figures are current or live actual times rather than fixed service standards, and independent or hands-on corroboration that real turnaround matches them.
